text.body:
rāvaṇabaiṭh iṣe tvā | jhailghreṣkhuḥ pphaṣkhīrpphaḥ phriṭphul || phrīlkhivgauḥ phruphelghīrbhul || pyīśkhrīskhāsjhailphīsnaus || josphaiḥ khyiścryaḥ phurbhiḥ kmrās ||
āpa undantu || khaṭphrelbharbharḍheḥ p | nauṣnaulphiśkhārhavjhaś || pīśphisnrau lbhra kbhnau lbhiṣbhirbhi ṣphūs | phaṭkhya vghi lghuḥ phīv || dhreḥ phīśgaul || kolgau vprelphūkpnyauvṇeṣbhraḥ pa ||
devasyatvā || ghrālchūḥ khrāḥ khaḥ pjhūldhūḥ pkhye vbhīṣ || pyaiśprirpphīḥ kchiḥ pjauv || bhrerkhaiṭbhāvghīlvrīṣkhālphāṣphūṣ || bośjau sjaul || nrau lḍrau skaḥ pchāvghuṣphūḥ pbo lbheṣ ||
ād degrāvan | phrīṣnrauṭphrīṣkheṭphelbhāṣphiḥ kphiś || kheṭjrauṣṭhrisphyūśpheśphūṣ || khaṭpheṣghīlchiḥ phrailghrais || phivṇiḥ kḍau lkhi sphrī ṭbhrīl || kherghāvpīśkhaśpheśkhrārḍau ṣbraḥ ktrūl || preḥ pcprairjhe śjau ṣchī sphraiṣkhailkhāś || khāṭpīḥ kmroḥ knau ṣphī sboḥ kgau ljo rghulcāskhal
devāsurāḥ anena krameṇaiva rāvaṇabaiṭsūtrāṇi vaktavyāni | idaṃ rāvaṇabaiṇṇāmalakṣaṇaṃ pratipañcāśathṣoḍaśavidhasandehanivarttakamiti jñeyam ||
ityūruhuḍyabhidhasaṃvasathevatīrṇa śrīrāmavedaviduṣasganayena tena | cakreṇa ṣoḍaśavidhaṃ parigṛhya lakṣyaṃ baiṇṇāmalakṣaṇamidaṃ racitaṃ samagram
rāvaṇabaiṭh iṣe tvā | ḍyaustarjyālkraḥ kyorjūrgarccalphal 1 kyālkāścyulkarḍyārjīvnyāśculbes 2 dyauvnāścyurjāskāvnyośnārghāśmeṣ 3 jorgyālkīśca ghalgūrttyarccālkyūrjūlkyārttigadholkelgudīlgyāvnigūlkerccārjyāvnaulgārjighīlguḥ kpūlkaḥ pphīś 4 dyūlphaṃ jyorphalphaṣkyav pharbas 5 nāvnīṣkūlgāskolkhaḥ kyūv bal 6 nyāstoḥ ppaṣke lpāścyūrttiḥ kphaḥ p 7 jyālgeḥ ktīśpeṣkeṣkyāścolkāvnīlgūṣkorccākyoścāsbīś ||
vāyavyaḥ śvetam pyaṃ būs 1 dyāpnorjyūlbhaḥ k 2 ḍyāḥ pkīścyāv bais 3 kyauśpārdyarccīṣpīṣkyāṣphel 4 pyarñcyūrphīṣ 5 pyaṃ baiḥ kbāv 6
prajāpatirakāmayata ḍyāv phūskyarccordyārjāljholparmmaul 1 cyārnnīśkīvnārppīskolkāśphañcyālpaḥ p 2 tyālgaḥ kyāśpārppaṃ pālbīs 3 ṭyaurgalgyaulkīrṇyārko vnyālkośbaḥ p 4 chūḥ kyardālbīv paṇḍūḥ kyauvnāvbhīr 5
yuñjānaḥ prathamam pīḥ kbīṣphūśphāv phov parppaḥ pbaḥ ppīlphalbar 1 phāv phūrphaḥ pphaṃ bhaṃ baḥ chaśpalbaiḥ chūlphāl 2 cyāv pīrccyaurttīvṇārnnyāv phoḥ ptīṣmeś 3 ṭyolko lmāḥ pṇyu lphaḥ k 4 bannyauḥ kphīv pal 5 vphaḥ kphīḥ pbaṃ boḥ phūṣphārphīr 6 dūlpyaṃ pīsphūspīḥ pbūs 7
sāvitrāṇi juhoti jyoḥ pphaur 1 ṇyauḥ pparppīr 2 pyāl 3 pyaul 4 dyustalkyālgīlpyauś 5 phaisphyāl 6 gyūrppīlkīśchaḥ kyarṭhaspaḥ pcīśkīśpyau śkarnnyaul 7
prācīnavaṃśaṃ pyaur 1 pyār 2 pyūr 3 pyair 4 pyer 5 ḍyaskarttyauś 6
prajananajyotiḥ ḍyaiṣkārdyūśkālkyaskarttyaul 1 phyauṃ 2 pyaṃ peṣkyārccīṣkyaul 3 pyauścauṣṇyargīḥ kparbūlkauḥ ptyāl 4 gyauskhargyaḥ kcālkalkyaskālkyar
hariḥ om iti rāvaṇabaiṇmūlaṃ saṃpūrṇam śrībhaktavatsalaparabrahmaṇe namaḥ
